create_localbuffer: create a LocalBuffer instance with n_slots, s_slots, and specs for agent state, output, and environment
get_free_slots: get k available free slots from the LocalBuffer for writing new trajectory data
write_to_buffer: write variables into specified slots of the LocalBuffer at the current position_in_slot index
get_single_slots: retrieve data from single slots as a TemporalDictTensor with optional erase to free slots
get_multiple_slots: retrieve and concatenate data from multiple trajectories as a TemporalDictTensor with optional erase
